relations.title: Ampliación de observación
relations.reading: Classifying what is missing can prevent a repository project from repeatedly asking for facts that no authority has yet established.

relations.title: Activación de misión
relations.reading: Mission activation can create the ownership and decision boundaries that further information gathering would otherwise leave unresolved.

relations.title: Observabilidad del proceso
relations.reading: A declaration about how performance will be judged can change both reported information and the behavior being observed.

relations.title: Suficiencia para una decisión
relations.reading: An unresolved fact may call for observation, while an unresolved authority condition may call for a legitimate declaration before action can proceed.

relations.title: Remanente no recuperable
relations.reading: Information that was never institutionally established differs from information that existed but cannot be recovered from the available record.

relations.title: Declaración provisional reversible
relations.reading: A bounded provisional declaration can enable discovery without being mistaken for the binding ownership decision that the investigation is meant to inform.

relations.title: Observabilidad del proceso
relations.reading: Introducing an observation rule can change the behaviour being measured; the Tuxpan account makes the purpose and adoption of telemetry part of the causal story.

relations.title: Suficiencia para una decisión
relations.reading: A locally supported answer from qualified evidence does not constitute an undeclared institutional fact or grant authority to act on it.
